message: Have fun. If the thesis defence is like that at some other insitutions, it's like a conversation between you, the writer, researcher, theorist, and other writer-researchers-scholars. And as conversations go, their questions are likely to be leading. Oh yeah, a defender at a defense sometimes judiciously declines to be baited. Graceful concession is also part of the conversation. But institutional mores vary. Your most difficult question: how is a thesis defense an act of investment as well as pure expenditure? by whom? when? I suspect your committee is looking forward to the enjoyable moment. Dr. Mike. Sounds nice, eh?!!
